race.description: Tom Cullen Memorial Coolgardie Sprint Hcp (70+)
race.comment: RAINLINE (4) won well here two back before going to Belmont last start and ending up 1.9L at the midweeks. Faithfull reunites with the mare nwo and while she has drawn wide, she does have good early speed. Rates highly on her recent form and she can get back to winning ways. CLOSE AT HAND (1) got well back last start and never featured after racing in Saturday grade two starts ago. His record at this track and trip is solid and Tsang's claim comes in handy. Watch for him flying late in the race. MORE LIKELY (10) made it a hat-trick of wins when resuming at this track and trip a fortnight ago. The form out of that has already been franked and things look to work out nicely for him. Can keep the streak alive. TACITO (9) looks well suited out in trip slightly and can turn in an improved effort. SCIENCE DEGREE (5) can be up front for a very long way.
